messages:
Maya (CSM): quick heads-up — during last week's onboarding run for Hydra we saw p95 token latency spike to ~1.8s during the 11:00–12:30 window. Not catastrophic but close to their SLA trigger. Thinking a light-weight intervention: try 8-bit quantized redwood-3-small for non-critical routes + brief canary routing for 1% traffic. Any objections? :thinking:

Tom (Solutions Eng): sounds reasonable. can we get a sample of peak payloads and the exact SLA target? I want to run a perf vs quality pass.

Maya (CSM): SLA target is p95 < 1.2s for interactive flows. attaching the minimal payload set I collected from their session replay (small sanitized set).

Lina (Hydra): thanks Maya — we did notice the UI jitter. we're fine with a canary but need checks on output parity. if quality drops on intent classification we're not comfortable. can we limit to lower-cost assistant routes first?

Tom (Solutions Eng): yes — plan: route "assistant-ltr" and preview endpoints to quantized model first, keep core classification on current fp16 model. I'll produce a quick diff on latency and token-level perplexity in ~20–30m.

Jared (Platform): we can create a canary route with an autoscale floor + immediate fallback. suggest TTL on KV-cache = 120s during the trial and continuous batching window to 25ms to keep latency predictable. also set rollback trigger: >5% degradation in top-1 intent F1.

Maya (CSM): Lina — would you be comfortable with 1% traffic canary for 48 hours and a 30-minute enablement call so Tom can walk through the validation checklist? we’ll keep you looped and can abort instantly. :white_check_mark:

Lina (Hydra): 1% for 48h + enablement call works. please also surface token-cost delta so our finance lead can sign off.

Tom (Solutions Eng): copying the quick commands i'll run now:
```bash
# perf harness (sanitized)
python ci/perf_run.py --model redwood-3-small-8bit --payload samples/hydra_peak.json --concurrency 16 --warmup 200
```
results in ~10–12m, will post numbers here.

deploy-bot: Canary route "hydra/quant-halo-1pct" created. rolling to 1% across us-west-2. monitor links: https://console.redwood/inference/canaries/hydra-quant-halo

Tom (Solutions Eng): initial perf: p95 down from 1.8s -> 1.05s on canary; token-cost -32% on sampled traces; top-1 intent F1 unchanged within 0.6%. raw logs: summarized in the linked gist. recommending expand to 5% after 2 hours of telemetry.

Maya (CSM): great — scheduling the 30m enablement session for tomorrow 10:00 PT. I'll invite Lina + finance + platform. thanks all, will capture feedback and next steps in the account health doc. :spiral_calendar:

Lina (Hydra): thanks everyone — we appreciate the proactive fix. will let finance know about the estimated cost savings.

Jared (Platform): setting an automated rollback monitor and a routing policy that prefers quantized variant only when concurrency < 40. I'll update the canary config.

Maya (CSM): noted. follow-up: I'll collect any quality edge cases during the 48h and we'll reconvene for a renewal risk check-in next week.

Tom (Solutions Eng): will post the perf artifacts + small eval harness so Hydra can run local checks if they want.

deploy-bot: Canary health ok — 3h passthrough with no rollback events.

Maya (CSM): thanks, closing loop for now.
